scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a DRAGON!
Is it the red egg, the blue egg, or the gold egg? Choose fast!
scenes.visual_prompt: red blue gold easter eggs row

scenes.narration: The RED egg opens and… it's just a rubber ducky! Quack quack!
The BLUE egg opens and… it's a pile of glitter! Whoops!
The GOLD egg opens and… ROAR! It's the dragon! You found it!
Did you pick gold? Come back tomorrow for Level 2!
